guide_notes: subject-agreement says 'tutti is plural' (tutti + sanno) but leaves out that bare tutti also takes noi and voi forms ('Tutti sappiamo che...', 'Tutti sapete che...'). An item with bare 'tutti' as subject must not offer a noi or voi form as a distractor.

The guide does not warn authors that in a pro-drop sentence any real person form is grammatical; in requests such as 'Scusi, ___ avere il conto?' posso and possiamo are both natural, so the subject must be forced by the sentence, not only by the English cue.
